Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of BAC.
We delivered record revenue of $36.6 billion this quarter, representing 13% year-over-year growth.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 21 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2020.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 140 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 13% to 23% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. We generated $13.9 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Revenue guidance of $36.6 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
